title: Imported item genome can claim isPreset and become undeletable
body:
## Summary
sanitizeItemGenome copies `isPreset: true` from an imported build code / JSON, so an import becomes a sticky preset the store refuses to delete.

## Description
src/lib/item-dna/defaults.ts:148 keeps `isPreset: obj.isPreset === true ? true : undefined`. src/stores/itemGenomeStore.ts:126 `if (target?.isPreset) return; // presets are sticky`, and LibraryTab hides Delete for presets (src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_inventory/dna-genome/LibraryTab.tsx:219). An import is user data, never a preset; fixed = the import path forces isPreset undefined (rehydrate merge may keep it for real presets). The file is outside this context (lib/item-dna), hence Lane B out-of-scope.

## Flow
- craft a build code whose JSON has isPreset:true
- Import -> Apply
- Library shows it under Presets with no Delete; deleteGenome silently refuses
- fix: strip isPreset in the import path (separate from the persist merge, which must keep it)

## Expected impact
Designers can always delete what they imported. Could break: the persist merge reuses sanitizeItemGenome and must keep real presets - split the flag handling.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - imported genomes are always deletable
Before: 1 of 1 imported isPreset:true genome undeletable (code read of defaults.ts:148 + store:126)
After: predicted 0; not built (out of paths)
Method: simulation - walked import -> store -> delete path; gate not reachable because lib/item-dna is outside this round
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: test: importGenome(sanitize({name,isPreset:true})) then deleteGenome(id) -> genome gone; plus merge test that persisted presets keep the flag

title: Luck Score is a hardcoded 72 while the copy says it is derived
body:
## Summary
RarityDistributionSection shows LUCK_SCORE=72 "based on deviation from expected rarity distribution", but nothing derives it from RARITY_DIST.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_inventory/economy/RarityDistributionSection.tsx:64-68 renders LUCK_SCORE and the caption "Based on deviation from expected rarity distribution at Level 14". src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_inventory/_shared/data-economy.ts:97 `export const LUCK_SCORE = 72;` - a literal. Edit RARITY_DIST and the score does not move. Fixed = compute it from RARITY_DIST with a pinned formula (e.g. 100 * (1 - 0.5 * sum|actual-expected|)) in the section, or relabel it as illustrative. _shared is owned by the inventory-economy-simulator context.

## Flow
- open Economy & Sourcing
- Luck Score 72 with a derived-sounding caption
- change RARITY_DIST -> still 72

## Expected impact
The one summary number on the panel becomes truthful. Could break: balance-prompt.ts reads RARITY_DIST, not LUCK_SCORE - no consumer of the literal besides this section (grep).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the displayed score follows its data
Before: 0 of 1 summary figures derived (literal at data-economy.ts:97)
After: predicted 1 of 1; with the formula above the current data gives 85, not 72
Method: simulation - formula walked on the 5 RARITY_DIST rows (sum|d| = 0.30)
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: test rendering the section with a mocked RARITY_DIST and asserting the score changes

title: Static 2450g Total Value sits inside the live packing planner
body:
## Summary
InventoryCapacitySection computes packing, fragmentation and per-type cells from the live stash, but prints Total Value from the constant INVENTORY_GOLD_VALUE.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_inventory/economy/EconomySourcingTab.tsx:153 renders `{INVENTORY_GOLD_VALUE}g` (data-economy.ts:64 = 2450) next to live metrics labelled "Live packing from the spatial stash" (line 77). An empty stash still reports 2450g. Fixed = sum item values from the stash tabs, or show it labelled as sample data.

## Flow
- empty the spatial stash
- panel shows 0/N cells and "Stash empty"
- Total Value still 2450g

## Expected impact
No contradictory figure in a live panel. Could break nothing; the value is a display only.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - live panel shows no static figure unlabelled
Before: 1 static figure among 5 live ones
After: predicted 0
Method: simulation - read of the render path with an empty stash
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: component test with an empty useAllStashTabs mock asserting Total Value is 0g or labelled sample

title: Inspect Item selector does not drive the sourcing sections
body:
## Summary
Selecting an item only opens the detail drawer; the Drop Source map stays hardcoded to Crystal Staff and the recipe card to SAMPLE_RECIPE.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_inventory/economy/EconomySourcingTab.tsx:184-226: selectedItem feeds ItemDetailDrawer only. DropSourceSection.tsx:18 hardcodes "Trace drop sources for Crystal Staff" over CRYSTAL_STAFF_SOURCES; CraftingRecipeSection renders SAMPLE_RECIPE. The context description promises tracing "where items come from economically" per item. There is no per-item drop/recipe data, so wiring it is a product decision about the data source (direction).

## Flow
- pick "Iron Longsword" in Inspect Item
- drop map still says Crystal Staff

## Expected impact
Sections answer the question the selector asks. Needs per-item drop/recipe data that does not exist yet.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - per-item sourcing
Before: 0 of 3 sourcing sections follow the selection
After: unmeasured - needs a data source decision
Method: simulation - code read; no instrument without data
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
instrument: operator decision: which store/table supplies per-item drop sources and recipes

title: Economy Sankey flow values are mouse-hover only and use 7-9px text
body:
## Summary
Link volumes appear only on onMouseEnter of SVG paths; node labels are fontSize 9 and values fontSize 7, under the 12px floor.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_inventory/economy/EconomySankeySection.tsx:101-108 (hover handlers on <path>, no focus/keyboard, no <title>), :121 fontSize 9, :128 fontSize 7. The svg has no role/aria-label. Fixed = an accessible table or <title> per link, focusable links, labels >=12px (viewBox scale). Distinct from the recorded game-economy-tuning deviation (sink semantics).

## Flow
- keyboard-tab into the Sankey: nothing focusable
- screen reader: unlabeled graphic

## Expected impact
Flow values readable without a mouse. Could break the 480px layout if labels grow - needs re-layout.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - flow values reachable by keyboard/AT
Before: 0 of 8 link values reachable without hover; 18 text nodes under 12px
After: predicted 8 of 8; 0 under floor
Method: simulation - counted from source
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: component test: each link has an accessible name with its value; legibility-floor guard extended to inline SVG fontSize

title: Monte Carlo runs synchronously inside startTransition; Simulating never paints
body:
## Summary
simulateRolls runs inside the transition callback on the main thread, so the pending label cannot render and a 10k batch blocks input for its full duration.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_inventory/dna-genome/MonteCarloSimulator.tsx:39-46 call simulateRolls(...) synchronously within startTransition; transitions only defer state updates, not the computation. Fixed = yield before computing (setTimeout/scheduler) or a worker, with a measured duration.

## Flow
- choose 10k iterations
- Run
- UI frozen until done; "Simulating..." never seen

## Expected impact
Responsive UI during large batches. Unmeasured: the 10k duration on a real machine decides whether this matters.

## Evaluation
Claim: performance - no long task on Run
Before: unmeasured duration for 10k rolls
After: unmeasured
Method: simulation - code read; timing probe not run this round
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: vitest timing probe of simulateRolls(10000) and a test that the pending label renders before results

title: 15 relative parent imports break the @/ alias convention in this context
body:
## Summary
CLAUDE.md mandates @/ imports; 7 files here import via ../../unique-tabs/_design, ../_shared/data, ../catalog/... .

## Description
Counts from grep "from '../": EconomySourcingTab.tsx 4, CraftingRecipeSection 2, DropSourceSection 2, EconomySankeySection 2, RarityDistributionSection 2, ItemScalingChart 1, dna-genome/index.tsx 2 = 15. Fixed = rewrite to @/components/modules/core-engine/... and pin with a source-scan test (comment-stripped) for these folders.

## Flow
- grep -c "from '../" over the context
- rewrite each to @/
- add a scan test so it stays 0

## Expected impact
Convention compliance; moves survive refactors. Could break nothing at runtime; typecheck verifies.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - convention violations
Before: 15 relative parent imports
After: predicted 0
Method: probe - grep count on the real tree; rewrite not built (churn budget)
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: source-scan test over sub_inventory/dna-genome and sub_inventory/economy (strip comments) asserting 0 relative parent imports

title: Monte Carlo iteration chips use a raw rgb() literal instead of a token
body:
## Summary
Unselected iteration chips colour text with rgb(148 163 184), bypassing the chart-colors / CSS-variable rule (ESLint only catches hex).

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_inventory/dna-genome/MonteCarloSimulator.tsx:65 `color: iterations === n ? ACCENT : 'rgb(148 163 184)'`. Fixed = var(--text-muted), which the rest of the file uses, so the chip follows the theme.

## Flow
- switch to light theme
- unselected chips keep a fixed slate grey

## Expected impact
Theme-consistent muted text. Nothing breaks.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - raw colour literals
Before: 1 raw rgb literal in the context
After: predicted 0
Method: probe - grep "rgb(" over the context: 1 hit
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: render test asserting unselected chip style.color is var(--text-muted)

title: ItemScalingChart renders NaN geometry for empty lines
body:
## Summary
With lines=[] or empty points, Math.min(...[]) is Infinity and every coordinate becomes NaN.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_inventory/economy/ItemScalingChart.tsx:18-25: minVal/maxVal/minLvl/maxLvl from spreads of possibly empty arrays; valRange = -Infinity - Infinity || 1 is -Infinity (truthy), so yScale yields NaN. Only consumer MechanicsScalingTab.tsx:170 passes static SCALING_LINES today, so latent. Fixed = early empty-state return.

## Flow
- render <ItemScalingChart lines={[]} .../>
- grid labels read NaN / -Infinity

## Expected impact
Safe once lines become data-driven. Nothing breaks.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - empty input
Before: NaN labels for empty input (walked)
After: predicted empty-state
Method: simulation - arithmetic walked
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: render test with lines=[] asserting no NaN in svg text

title: Genome delete is one click with no confirm or undo
body:
## Summary
EditorTab and LibraryTab delete a custom or bred genome immediately and permanently (persisted store), with no ConfirmDialog or undo.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_inventory/dna-genome/EditorTab.tsx delete button and src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_inventory/dna-genome/LibraryTab.tsx:219-225,296 call onDelete directly -> itemGenomeStore.deleteGenome. The shared ui/ConfirmDialog exists for destructive actions. Fixed = confirm (or an undo toast) for genomes with lineage/evolution.

## Flow
- Library -> trash icon on a bred genome
- gone, persisted, no undo

## Expected impact
Fewer lost bred/evolved genomes. Could add friction; undo is the lighter option - a design choice.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - recoverable delete
Before: 3 delete sites, 0 confirm/undo
After: predicted 0 unrecoverable deletes
Method: simulation - code read
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: component test: delete click opens ConfirmDialog; cancel keeps the genome in the store
